'''Groona Biddle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] colonist living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was approached by an infamous con artist [[Gault Rennow]], posing as "Gellar Roing", who offered to sell him [[Salt/Legends|Salt]], highly addictive to Arcona and disguised as compound for maximizing water retention in organics.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Groona Biddle appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in hologram during Gault Rennow companion storyline.
